df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

transport_df = df[df['sector'].str.upper() == "TRANSPORTATION"].copy()

# Aggregate operating profit by company (or another suitable dimension)

agg_df = transport_df.groupby("company")["operating_profit"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

file_path = "/mnt/data/assistant-1vi2Nw7ZD7wv5KgHBa9SWH-synthetic_500_quarterly_results.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Ensure numeric
df["operating_profit"] = pd.to_numeric(df["operating_profit"], errors="coerce")

transport_df = df[df['sector'].str.upper() == "TRANSPORTATION"].copy()

agg_df = transport_df.groupby("name")["operating_profit"].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)

plt.figure(figsize=(14,6))
ax = agg_df.plot(kind="bar", color="#2a6fbb")
ax.set_title("Total Operating Profit - TRANSPORTATION Sector (All Quarters)")
ax.set_ylabel("Operating Profit")
ax.set_xlabel("Company")
plt.tight_layout()

output_path = "/mnt/data/transportation_operating_profit_barchart.png"
plt.savefig(output_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches="tight")
plt.close()

output_path
